    Step 1 — Definitions:
      f_a       = 1/(exp(E_a/T_a) + 1)                         [Fermi-Dirac occupation of BdG mode a; quasi-free separating condition]
      E_a       = √(ξ_a² + Δ_a²)                               [BdG quasiparticle energy; ξ_a = normal-state dispersion, Δ_a = pairing gap]
      Δ_a       > 0  (BdG gap)                                 [3He-B BDI gapped; Volovik Paper 05 Eq.60 CdGM ladder; the +1/2 minigap, no exact zero]
      T_a       = 1/β_a,  0 < β_a < ∞                          [finite generalized-temperature of the QUENCHED GGE; P_exc=1.000 certifies finite (saturated-but-finite pair production)]
      K_a       = log[(1 − f_a)/f_a]                           [fermionic modular Hamiltonian; the modular generator on mode a]
      W_GGE(k)  = n_k + 1/2                                    [bosonic Wightman zero-point weight; floor +1/2]

    Step 2 — Substitution (fermionic faithfulness; plug E_a ≥ Δ_a > 0 and finite β_a):
      Since E_a = √(ξ_a² + Δ_a²) ≥ Δ_a > 0 and 0 < β_a < ∞,
        E_a/T_a = β_a·E_a  is FINITE and STRICTLY POSITIVE (β_a > 0, E_a > 0),
        so exp(E_a/T_a) ∈ (1, ∞) FINITE,
        so f_a = 1/(exp(E_a/T_a) + 1) ∈ (0, 1/2) ⊂ (0, 1).
      The boundary f_a = 0 requires exp(E_a/T_a) → ∞ ⇔ E_a/T_a → ∞ ⇔ β_a → ∞ (T→0 vacuum), EXCLUDED by finite β_a.
      The boundary f_a = 1 requires exp(E_a/T_a) → 0 ⇔ E_a/T_a → −∞, IMPOSSIBLE since E_a > 0, β_a > 0.

    Step 3 — Simplification (normality; substitute the strict-interior f_a into K_a):
      K_a = log[(1 − f_a)/f_a].
      Since f_a ∈ (0, 1) STRICTLY (Step 2), both (1 − f_a) > 0 and f_a > 0,
        so (1 − f_a)/f_a ∈ (0, ∞) FINITE and POSITIVE,
        so K_a = log[finite positive] is FINITE: |K_a| < ∞.
      K_a diverges (+∞) ONLY at f_a → 0 (empty) and (−∞) at f_a → 1 (filled) — both excluded by finite β_a (Step 2).

    Step 4 — Direction read-off:
      f_a ∈ (0, 1) STRICTLY  ⇒  ω|_{A_hor} has NO null direction on the fermionic channel ⇒ FAITHFUL.
      |K_a| < ∞              ⇒  the modular Hamiltonian is finite ⇒ the modular flow is well-defined ⇒ NORMAL.
      W_GGE(k) = n_k + 1/2 ≥ 1/2 > 0  ⇒  bosonic channel faithful (floor never vanishes; near-vacuous).
      The SINGLE physical fact 0 < β_a < ∞ (finite generalized-temperature of the frozen relic, P_exc=1.000)
      drives BOTH consequences: faithfulness (f∈(0,1)) AND normality (|K|<∞).

    Conclusion:
      The frozen GGE restriction to A_hor is faithful AND normal on the named horizon blocks,
      so the modular operator Δ_ω exists (Tomita-Takesaki), and the corridor is OPEN — UNLESS
      an ACCIDENTAL BdG degeneracy on a named block produces a hard f_a → 0/1 that the analytic
      BDI argument did not enumerate (the FAIL branch: a sharp NEW closure reason, distinct from
      INTEG-39, which tests ergodic thermalization, an ORTHOGONAL predicate).

## Wave 2 Execution Notes

- **Python**: `"phonon-exflation-sim/.venv312/Scripts/python.exe"` for every script (GPU-enabled venv; see `.claude/rules/math-scripts.md §"Environment"`). Items 2/3 ship per-block matrices to `torch.linalg` on the RX 9070 XT (cross-check first few eigenvalues vs `numpy.linalg` on a test block). Item 1 is text I/O; item 4 is symbolic + a scalar ratio (CPU-cap OMP8 if numpy is used).
- **Output**: scripts → `computations/session-105/s105_w2_*.py`; verdict file + npz + png → `computations/session-105/`.
- **Verdict file**: `computations/session-105/s105_gate_verdicts.txt` (canonical path per `gate-verdicts.md`). Scripts `print_verdict_payload` (compute the dual SHAs + value); the agent calls the `emit_verdict` MCP tool (race-safe; never a raw `open("a")` append). Item 3 carries the `[SIGN]` 3-tuple companion row; item 4 carries the `[SIGN]` 3-tuple companion row; item 1 carries the dual-SHA companion row only.
- **Verdict source pointer**: `verdict_source: computations/session-105/s105_gate_verdicts.txt` (NEVER `expected_verdicts: [...]`).
- **Intra-wave gating**: the coordinator MUST verify `S105-W2-2-OMEGA-FAITHFUL-NORMAL` lands **PASS** in the verdict file BEFORE dispatching `S105-W2-3-AREA-MODULAR-AGREEMENT`. On non-PASS, item 3 closes PRE-REG-INC via an orchestrator-authored mechanical-closure script (per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md`), and the WP §W2-3 section is updated in the same run.
- **Each gate writes results ONLY to its designated WP section** (`### §W2-{i}. {GATE_ID}` in `sessions/session-105/session-105-w2-workingpaper.md`).
- No TeamCreate — all four gates are independent Agent tool calls (item 3 sequenced after item 2's PASS).
